U-0001.summary: Keep Codec's Base64 output as sun.misc.BASE64Encoder wrote it on Java 21: java.util.Base64's MIME encoder with 76-character lines and the platform line separator (and the separator the old encoder added after a full last line), and the MIME decoder, which skips the line breaks as BASE64Decoder.decodeBuffer did.
review_notes: The old encoder's line separator was the platform's (it printed with println), so the output still differs between Windows and Linux, as it did on Java 8.

edits.search: private static final Charset UTF8 = Charset.forName("UTF-8");

U-0004.summary: Replace the two anonymous Comparators OpenRewrite left (Ledger.sorted and Report.summary) with lambdas, and drop the Comparator imports they no longer need. Neither had state or used this, and Collections.sort stays stable, so the order is the same.

U-0007.summary: Make Money a record: its two components are the fields it had, the constructor's check moves into a compact constructor, and the record's equals replaces the hand-written one, which compared the same two fields. getCents and getCurrency stay, so no caller changes; hashCode and toString stay as they were.
review_notes: Money is public API of the library: a record can't be extended and gains cents() and currency() accessors besides the getters.
